The Disruption Vulnerability Index — Resilinc's own score of how exposed this supplier is to supply disruption, on a scale of 0–10. Higher means more vulnerable.

A band (Low/Medium/High/Severe) summarizing this supplier's financial stability — bankruptcy filings, credit downgrades, and similar signals that could affect their ability to keep supplying.

Foreign Ownership, Control or Influence — whether a foreign entity holds enough ownership or influence over this supplier to affect its decisions. Majority foreign ownership (over 50%) is treated as High.

The Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List — companies CBP has determined use forced labor, whose goods are presumptively barred from U.S. import.

CBP UFLPA Entity List, added 14 Jun 2024. Exact name match.
